args.title: Reset export button state after a failed export
args.body: File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx. The handleClick function's call to exportReport only resets busy state and shows a toast in the success path (.then), with no .catch or error handling. When the export promise rejects (e.g. server error), busy stays true forever, leaving the button greyed out until a page reload. Fix by adding a .catch (or try/catch with async/await) that resets setBusy(false) and shows an error toast on failure, ensuring the button becomes clickable again after a failed export.
